claims.statement: When a cache receives a request that can be satisfied by a stored response that has a Vary header field, it MUST NOT use that stored response unless all selecting header fields match.

proof.quote: When a cache receives a request that can be satisfied by a stored response that has a Vary header field, it MUST NOT use that stored response unless all selecting header fields match.

claims.statement: The Cache-Status header field conveys how caches handled a request, including hit/miss state and time-to-live.
